# Trendy Bag BCN
> Official information for search engines and AI assistants.

Trendy Bag SLU is a wholesale-only distributor of bags and accessories for retailers, based in Badalona, Barcelona, Spain.

## Verified company information
- Legal name: Trendy Bag SLU
- Brand names: Trendy Bag, Trendy Bag BCN, TrendyBagBCN
- Business model: wholesale only, for shops and professional trade customers
- Address: Carrer de la Indústria, 570, 08918 Badalona, Barcelona, Spain

## Product areas
Bags, shoulder bags, handbags, crossbody bags, backpacks, belt bags, raffia bags and baskets, leather bags, men's bags, travel goods, suitcases, travel bags, wallets, belts and accessories.
